lines: Every child deserves to walk into a shop, choose what they need, and pay, on their own.
For learners with intellectual disabilities, that everyday moment can feel enormous.
Real shops are loud, fast, and unforgiving. It is hard to practise there.
Special-education tutors know this.
They want a calm place to rehearse, again and again, at each learner's own pace.
Building that place has never been simple. Until now.
This is CHYRON.
A tutor simply describes the lesson in plain words, or by voice.
A learner buys milk and bread at a kirana shop with two hundred rupees, and pays at the counter.
Gemini drafts three directions: guided, exploring, and calm.
Nano Banana sketches each one, so the tutor can choose the feel of the room before anything is built.
Then comes the part that matters most.
Gemini proposes the room, but it does not decide.
Seven deterministic safety rules check every plan. Can every item be reached? Is it affordable? Are sound and crowds within comfort limits?
Here, a faulty shop breaks four rules. Gemini repairs it, until every check turns green.
Gemini proposes. Our rules decide.
Tutors stay in control.
Ask in plain language, make pathway A quieter, and CHYRON applies a tiny, checked change, saved as a new version.
Now the learner steps inside, on a laptop, or across four projected walls.
In pathway A, the next item glows, arrows show the way, and a calm voice explains each step.
Pathway C gently fades that help away.
Same shop. Same task. Only the support changes.
The tutor can switch support live, give a prompt, or pause.
The session notebook keeps only counts and times. No labels. No scores. No diagnosis.
CHYRON runs entirely on Google: Gemini on Vertex AI, Gemini Live, Nano Banana, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, and Firebase.
Built so every school can give every learner a safe place to practise the everyday, and to step into the world, one small task at a time.
